description: This file provides internationalization (i18n) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin specific to Traditional Chinese (zh-TW). It defines messages for user input validation, loading states, selection limits, and search results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should delete extra characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no matching items were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating search in progress.
